spans.s: Containing the word (इडा) (such as a chapter).
Belonging to a sheep. -डः N. of Purūravas (इडाया अपत्यम्); cf.
ऐड [aiḍa] डू [ḍū] कम् [kam], (डू) कम् A wall &c. of bones and rubbish.
ऐडक [aiḍaka], a. (-की f.) Belonging to a sheep. -कः A species of sheep.
ऐड(ल)विडः(लः) N. of Kubera. अवलम्बितैलविल- पाणिपल्लवः Śi.13.18.
